evidence.title: UNdata Sources catalog and update calendar

fallback_policy.access_failure: Continue public metadata mapping, record a typed blocker, and never infer observation availability.
fallback_policy.change: Fingerprint the bounded universe and reopen affected checks and stages when upstream structure or version changes.
fallback_policy.scale: Partition by a stable native order or manifest; preserve counts, range boundaries, and checksums.
fallback_policy.semantic_ambiguity: Retain source-native elements, defer Variable or Construct promotion, and request human review when consequential.
fallback_policy.unknown_structure: Use open_world_custom; preserve observed facts; propose a reusable route only after evidence and tests.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Official identity and institutional evidence with canonical GRDR references.
required_facets.requirement: Resolve canonical source identity, aliases, responsible institutions, and database boundary.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Evidence-backed provenance chain with unresolved roles explicitly recorded.
required_facets.requirement: Separate original production, collection, harmonization, derivation, publication, mirroring, and maintenance roles.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Boundary statement, enumeration rule, dated evidence, and known denominator or explicit non-enumerable limitation.
required_facets.requirement: Define a reproducible dated, versioned, partitioned, question-bounded, or rolling universe and denominator strategy.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Official version/change documentation or repeated probes with a refresh policy.
required_facets.requirement: Identify snapshot, release, revision, append, rolling, deletion, and schema-change behavior.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Current authoritative policy evidence and any required human authorization gate.
required_facets.requirement: Record licenses, terms, citation, attribution, privacy, ethics, sovereignty, retention, and redistribution controls.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Official dataset metadata, method documentation, and canonical Dataset record.
required_facets.requirement: Resolve unit identity, producer, population or universe, observation unit, method, coverage, release, limitations, and citation.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Quality or methodology evidence and explicit unknown/not-applicable decisions.
required_facets.requirement: Record missingness, suppression, imputation, uncertainty, calibration, revisions, bias, and comparability limits where applicable.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Versioned schema, codebook, manifest, instrument, graph, array, stream, or observed structure.
required_facets.requirement: Recover the source-native organization without substituting an access URL for structure.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Reproducible count, ordering or manifest, and canonical DataElement coverage.
required_facets.requirement: Enumerate native fields, dimensions, measures, identifiers, attributes, flags, items, coordinates, or annotations within the declared boundary.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Official definitions plus structural selections, units, population, resolution, and comparability.
required_facets.requirement: Define research-matchable operational quantities without inferring them from topic labels.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Evidence-backed mappings with directness and scope limitations.
required_facets.requirement: Link variables to constructs while distinguishing direct, subjective, administrative, constructed, modelled, forecast, proxy, and latent measures.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Key definitions and a tested or explicitly limited joinability assessment.
required_facets.requirement: Document entity identifiers, time keys, spatial keys, version keys, linkage assumptions, collision risks, and identity resolution.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Dated access probes or evidenced controlled-access procedure covering every required route.
required_facets.requirement: Test metadata and observation access separately and record authentication, limits, formats, environment, query, and reproducibility conditions.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Machine-recomputed SHA-256 fingerprints for the plan, scope, and unit manifest match the persisted execution locks.
required_facets.requirement: Lock the audited plan, declared scope, and ordered work-unit manifest so an Agent cannot silently change the target, denominator, routes, or completion claim.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Replay tests and current project history reproduce the same next target and validate every checkpoint checksum.
required_facets.requirement: Persist deterministic checkpoints and resume the first unfinished target without skipping, substitution, or loss after process, network, or session interruption.

required_facets.completion_evidence: A bounded, counted, connected, fingerprinted canonical structural spine whose nodes and relationships are all verified or explicitly evidenced not applicable.
required_facets.requirement: Recover the complete source-native structural graph from Dataset through recursive DataStructure nodes and DataElements to operational Variables, including grain, keys, ordering, cardinality, lineage, roots, leaves, and edges.

required_facets.completion_evidence: A bounded, counted, connected, fingerprinted semantic spine using canonical SemanticNode and Construct records with source-native and external classification mappings preserved.
required_facets.requirement: Recover the multi-parent scientific-semantic graph from disciplines and subdisciplines through research objects, systems, phenomena, processes, populations and units to Constructs without reducing it to topic strings.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Every bridge node and relationship is counted, verified, fingerprinted, and exposes measurement directness, units, population, resolution, comparability, and join conditions.
required_facets.requirement: Prove the canonical bridge connecting source-native DataElements and DataStructures to research-matchable Variables and evidenced Constructs or scientific-semantic nodes.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Complete bounded catalog traversal with stable native identifiers.
required_facets.requirement: Preserve catalog, collection, dataset, version, and distribution hierarchy.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Every distribution linked as an access Resource with format and rights.
required_facets.requirement: Separate datasets from their files, APIs, landing pages, mirrors, and distributions.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Stable manifest or deterministic listing with counts and checksums where available.
required_facets.requirement: Enumerate path, object identity, version, size, media type, packaging, checksum, and nesting.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Format-specific probe results and required software or keys without exposing secrets.
required_facets.requirement: Test lawful extraction and decoding for every distinct required format, including compression and encryption boundaries.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Machine schema or reproducible introspection covering the bounded table universe.
required_facets.requirement: Recover schemas, tables, views, columns, types, nullability, constraints, primary/foreign keys, and row grain.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Field lineage, calculation logic, code lists, and canonical variable mapping.
required_facets.requirement: Distinguish stored, computed, denormalized, coded, and externally joined fields.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Official machine schema or dated endpoint inventory with representative successful and failing probes.
required_facets.requirement: Enumerate endpoints, operations, request/response schemas, parameters, pagination, filters, and error semantics.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Documentation plus bounded live probes that do not bypass controls.
required_facets.requirement: Record authentication, scopes, quotas, rate limits, pagination caps, timeouts, retries, and nondeterminism.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Versioned DSD/schema and complete referenced code-list inventory.
required_facets.requirement: Resolve measure, ordered dimensions, time dimension, codelists, attributes, units, multipliers, flags, and attachment levels.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Complete declared variable universe linked to native dimension codes.
required_facets.requirement: Define each variable by measure plus all meaning-bearing dimension selections.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Dated probes recording query keys, response status, units, flags, and failures.
required_facets.requirement: Test structure metadata and observation retrieval independently.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Manifest/schema and annotation protocol covering the bounded corpus.
required_facets.requirement: Recover corpus, item, version, segment, transcript/OCR, language, annotation, and label hierarchy.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Rights and methodology evidence with known exclusions and bias limits.
required_facets.requirement: Record item-level rights, takedowns, provenance, sampling/collection bias, representation, and annotation reliability.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Evidence-backed lineage that does not assign aggregator claims to producers or vice versa.
required_facets.requirement: Identify original producers, exact upstream datasets/versions, acquisition dates, transformations, harmonization, models, and revision propagation.

required_facets.completion_evidence: Transformation/method evidence and variable-level comparability status.
required_facets.requirement: Record definition crosswalks, unit conversions, rebasing, imputations, model assumptions, breaks, and non-equivalence.

scope.boundary_statement: Every one of the 36 ordered datamarts in the official UNdata Sources catalog retrieved on 2026-08-21; the six separately listed glossaries are access/documentation sidecars rather than Dataset work units.

work_unit_strategy.identity_rule: Use the official UNdata DataMart block id together with the existing canonical GRDR Dataset id.
work_unit_strategy.ordering_rule: Preserve the official DataMartInfo.aspx dataset order.
work_unit_strategy.partition_rule: Exactly one work unit per ordered official datamart; retain archived, deprecated, static-presentation, and temporarily unavailable entries.
